deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: To embed a returns reason capture form into Shopify's returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to the 'Apps' section.
2. Click on 'Manage apps' and then click on 'Install app' to install the 'Returns Reason Capture' app.
3. After installation, navigate to the 'Settings' section and click on 'Returns' under the 'Policies' section.
4. Scroll down to the 'Returns reason capture' section and toggle the switch to 'Enabled'.
5. In the 'Returns reason capture form' section, select the desired form layout and customize the form fields as needed.
6. To display the returns reason capture form on the returns page, navigate to the 'Themes' section and click on 'Actions' > 'Edit code'.

7. In the 'layout.liquid' file, add the following code snippet to display the returns reason capture form: `{% if settings.returns_reason_capture_enabled %} <form id='returns-reason-capture-form'> <!-- form fields will be generated dynamically --> </form> {% endif %}`,
8. Save the changes and preview the returns page to ensure the form is displayed correctly.
9. Finally, configure the form submission settings to send the captured returns reason to your desired email address or third-party service.
